notes.en: Aimed for an authentic Renaissance engraved study built on a bold gold silhouette so the four-limb Vitruvian overlay and geometric frame remain distinct down to 16px, while tiered aged-ink etching brings out muscular anatomy, curly hair, and a stern gaze at larger scales. The foreshortened feet and small hand details remain somewhat schematic due to the stroke-weight limits needed to prevent dark clumping.
